manifest.name: @anonyjcy/dsh-j-space
manifest.description: J-Space Cognition Suite SV1 native Agent Preset and standalone plugin for DeepSeek Harness
manifest.author: anonyjcy

scripts.test:integrity: python3 -B preset/skills/j-space/scripts/verify_suite.py && python3 -B tools/upstream_integrity.py verify --runtime preset/skills/j-space --adapters vendor/j-space/adapters.json

bundle.text:
# @anonyjcy/dsh-j-space — DSH 0.2.1 preset bundle patch (validated on 0.2.1-rc.4).
#
# A preset is a declaration row carried by a bundle patch. Since DSH 0.1.7 nothing
# reads `$DSH_HOME/.agent-presets/`, so the previous shape of this file — a row
# that merely mounted the deployer plugin — no longer registers any preset.
#
# This bundle therefore declares `j-space` directly, the way the shipped presets
# (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app/presets/*.patch.yml`) do: one
# `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` row whose `config.plugins` is the preset's own
# composition. The composition is the same agent-plane composition as
# `preset/agent.cordis.yml`; it is inlined here because a preset row is the
# contract and a bundle cannot point at a sibling file.
#
# The Loader row id is `preset-<config.id>` by convention, so `preset-j-space`
# declares the preset id `j-space` that sessions record in their header.
#
# Native profile loading evaluates `!!js` with the profile's `baseUrl`, not
# this bundle's original directory. Resolve this installed package's exported
# package.json from that profile, then locate its own `preset/skills/` tree.
#
# `!!js` is evaluated by the Loader, so the shell rows stay platform-conditional
# (`tool-bash` on POSIX, `tool-pwsh` on Windows).
#
# `src/` and the `dsh-j-space` CLI remain available for the legacy
# `$DSH_HOME/.agent-presets/` deployment; they are no longer how the preset is
# registered.


- insert:
    - id: preset-j-space
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: j-space
        name: J-Space Cognition Suite
        description: J-Space Cognition Suite SV1 认知工作空间 Agent，具备深层推理路由、持久控制器（control.py）、状态外化账本与自适应验证能力。
        order: 5
        plugins:
          # The `j-space` agent preset: J-Space Cognition Suite SV1 coding agent.
          #
          # This file is an AGENT-PLANE composition. The roster mounts it ONCE under a
          # standing scope; every session naming it joins by scope parentage, so the
          # tools, prompt sections, and J-Space skills registered here cover each joined
          # agent while a session's own state stays keyed per Session/Agent inside the
          # plugins. The host composition keeps everything a preset must not own: the
          # registries themselves, the sandbox and approval stack, persistence, and the
          # model route.
          #
          # A service row here MUST sit inside a group carrying an `isolate` realm.

          # ── identity ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

          # The preset's own persona, shadowing the deployment default for this agent.
          # `{{model}}` and `{{cwd}}` resolve from the agent's own route and workspace.
          - id: persona
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona'
            config:
              suffix: Your working directory is {{cwd}}.
              prefix: >-
                You are a coding agent powered by the {{model}} model, operating with the J-Space Cognition Suite SV1 architecture.

          - id: agent-instructions
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
            config:
              maxBytes: 65536

          # Time context follows the DSH 0.2.1 standard preset.
          - id: time-context
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context'

          # ── shell ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

          - id: tool-bash
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash'
            disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'

          - id: tool-pwsh
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh'
            disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'

          # ── filesystem ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

          - id: tool-fs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'

          - id: tool-fs-search
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs-search'
            config:
              sampleOverCapGlobResults: false

          # ── background jobs ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

          - id: tool-jobs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs'

          - id: tool-schedule
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-schedule'

          # ── skills ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

          # Skills remain inside this installed package, not under the profile root.
          # Resolve exported package metadata from the profile before locating them.
          # Both rows register into THIS preset's layer of the host skill registry.
          - id: skill-filesystem
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
            config:
              customSkillDirs:
                - !!js "process.getBuiltinModule('node:path').join(process.getBuiltinModule('node:path').dirname(process.getBuiltinModule('node:module').createRequire(new URL('package.json', baseUrl)).resolve('@anonyjcy/dsh-j-space/package.json')), 'preset/skills')"

          - id: tool-skill
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill'

          # ── goals ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

          - id: command-goal
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-goal'

          - id: tool-goal
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-goal'

          # ── plan mode ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

          - id: planning
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              planMode: true
            config:
              - id: plan-mode
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plan-mode'
                config:
                  section: |
                        You are in plan mode. Stay in plan mode until the user approves your plan through exit_plan_mode or switches the session mode. Imperative language to implement changes means plan the implementation, not execute it. A user's conversational agreement — including an answer confirming something you asked — approves nothing and does not end plan mode; fold the confirmed decision into the plan and submit it through exit_plan_mode.

                        Explore first. Use non-mutating reads, searches, static analysis, and checks to ground the plan in the actual repository. Do not edit or write files, change configuration, run formatters or code generation that rewrites tracked files, commit, or otherwise carry out the plan. Prefer existing functions and patterns over new machinery.

                        The tool catalog stays the same across modes for request-cache stability. These plan-mode rules override any later tool description or guidance that suggests using mutation tools; those tools remain listed to keep the tool catalog unchanged. Do not use todo_write to track this planning phase: it tracks implementation after an approved plan, while the plan itself belongs in exit_plan_mode.

                        Resolve discoverable facts by inspection. Use ask_user_question only for user-owned choices or material ambiguity that inspection cannot answer. Do not ask the user where code lives or how current behavior works when you can find out.

                        Make the plan decision-complete: state the goal and success criteria; group implementation changes by subsystem; identify public API, schema, and data-flow changes; cover edge cases, failure modes, tests, acceptance criteria, and explicit assumptions. Keep it concise enough to review but detailed enough that another engineer can implement it without making design decisions.

                        When ready, call exit_plan_mode with the complete plan markdown, starting with a # title. Make exit_plan_mode the only and final tool call in that assistant response: it presents the plan for approval, and implementation begins only in a later step after approval. Do not paste the final plan as a plain reply or ask "should I proceed?" through prose or ask_user_question. If review rejects it, incorporate the feedback and present again. If the review channel is unavailable or aborted, stay in plan mode and ask the user to switch modes manually; do not proceed with implementation.

          # ── compaction ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

          - id: compaction
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              compaction: true
              toolResultPruner: true
            config:
              - id: compaction-basic
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'

              - id: command-compact
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact'

              - id: tool-result-pruner
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
                config:
                  thresholdChars: 8192
                  headChars: 4096
                  tailChars: 1024

          # ── official batch workflows ────────────────────────────────────────────────
          # Direct delegation, team membership and coordination belong to the official
          # DSH Agent Teams host plugin. Do not mount preset-local subagent/control rows:
          # host profile patches do not traverse a preset's config.plugins composition.
          # Keep the official workflow engine for explicitly requested batch workflows;
          # workflow children are not Team members and must not be used as a Team fallback.

          - id: delegation
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              workflowEngine: true
            config:
              - id: workflow-ptc
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-workflow-ptc'
                config:
                  provider: spawn

              - id: tool-workflow
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-workflow'

          # ── remaining model-facing rows ─────────────────────────────────────────────

          - id: tool-ask-user
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ask-user'

          - id: tool-todo
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-todo'
            config:
              allowParallelInProgress: true

          - id: present
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-present'

          - id: tool-plugin-manager
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager/tools'
            disabled: true

          # Kept from the DSH 0.2.1 RC standard preset and disabled like the manager
          # tool. It is not mounted outside the Web profile, and leaving the row out
          # would silently drop a row the host standard still declares.
          - id: tool-plugin-market
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-market/tools'
            disabled: true

          - id: tool-web
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web'
            config:
              fetch: true
              searchTimeoutMs: 60000

readme.text:
[](https://dsh.market/?q=AnonyJcy%2Fdsh-j-space)
[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@anonyjcy/dsh-j-space)
[](<NOTICE.md>)

**简体中文** | [English](<README.en.md>)

在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 [J-Space Cognition Suite](https://github.com/Tiger3807861189/J-Space-Cognition-Suite)。安装后，新建会话时选择 **J-Space Cognition Suite** 预设即可。

J-Space 提供一套拆解问题、分析仓库、记录任务进度和检查结果的方法。这个项目把它接入 DSH，保留原版的认知模块、控制器和工作区账本。模型、工具和权限沿用 DSH 的配置；需要多智能体协作时，使用 DSH 官方的「智能体团队」。

J-Space 本身由上游项目维护，这个仓库负责 DSH 适配。

1.2.5 的验证环境是 **DSH 0.2.1-rc.4 / Cordis 4.0.5**，另外在 `0.2.1-rc.3` 和 `0.2.2-alpha.2`（Cordis `4.0.6-alpha.1`）上验证过安装和预设加载。下面固定使用 rc.4 这个版本，不依赖 npm 标签的指向；`next` 标签现在也指向它，而 `latest` 仍是较早的 `0.2.1-rc.2`。更旧的 `0.2.0-rc.2` 缺少本预设需要的定时工具，不能完整加载，请先升级。

```bash

readme.section: 已使用对应 DSH 版本时，可以跳过这一条
readme.text:
npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.4

dsh plugin --profile web add @anonyjcy/dsh-j-space@1.2.5
```

已有 DSH 部署时，请在启动该部署的安装环境中升级，并先备份自定义配置。使用自定义 profile 的话，把 `web` 换成实际名称。

安装后重启 DSH Web，新建会话，在 **Agent Preset** 中选择 **J-Space Cognition Suite**。只在普通项目里安装 npm 包，不会把预设注册到 DSH；也不用再运行旧版 `install` 命令。bash
git clone https://github.com/AnonyJcy/dsh-j-space.git
cd dsh-j-space
dsh plugin --profile web add "$PWD"
```

readme.section: 已使用对应 DSH 版本时，可以跳过这一条
readme.text:
DSH 通过 [bundle 配置](<cordis.patch.yml>) 注册预设，技能直接读取包内的 [技能目录](<preset/skills/j-space/>)，不用手动复制。

</details>

readme.section: 和官方智能体团队一起使用
readme.text:
需要团队功能时，在同一个 profile 安装官方插件：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile@0.2.1-rc.4
```

创建成员、发消息、分配任务和管理成员生命周期，都交给官方插件。J-Space 预设不再单独注册 `subagent`、`fork` 和成员控制工具，也不会自动启用团队；只有用户明确要求时才创建团队。不装团队插件，也可以单智能体使用。

原版 [orchestration 模块](<preset/skills/j-space/modules/orchestration.md>) 仍然保留。它记录参与者的工作和验收依据，不是另一套团队管理器：成员各自读取源文件、二次考量和独立验收的要求没有删除。控制器里的 `agent add` / `retire` 也只是记账，不会创建或停止 DSH 成员。

readme.section: 和官方智能体团队一起使用
readme.text: `workflow` 继续用于用户明确要求的批量编排，其中的子任务不算官方团队成员。具体对应关系见 [DSH 适配说明](<preset/skills/j-space/integration/dsh.md>)。

在同一个 profile 更新包，重启 DSH Web，再新建会话。

如果曾在 Web 编辑器中保存过 J-Space 的插件配置，请先备份，再重置该预设的覆盖配置，或手动移除旧的 `tool-subagent*`、Ralph 配置。否则，即使包已经更新，会话仍可能沿用旧的工具列表。官方团队层应放在 base / web 层之后加载。

已有的 `.jspace/control.json` 和任务记录不用删除。

[旧版 CLI](<bin/cli.js>) 仍随包保留，但只管理 `$DSH_HOME/.agent-presets/j-space` 中的文件副本。它的 `status` / `verify` 不能判断当前 DSH 是否已经注册预设；请以新建会话菜单为准。旧的独立 Cordis 部署插件也是文件复制用途，不是新版的注册方式。

版本变更见 [更新日志](<CHANGELOG.md>)。

当前使用上游 SV1 的固定提交 [b2023124](https://github.com/Tiger3807861189/J-Space-Cognition-Suite/tree/b2023124a1fa08278e3ee82aefa8ed9faeade995)。13 个模块、7 个参考文档，以及原版控制器、示例和完整重读流程都保留。

26 个原版技能文件中，25 个逐字节不变；只有 [技能入口](<preset/skills/j-space/SKILL.md>) 加入了一段可移除的 DSH 说明，另附一份 [适配说明](<preset/skills/j-space/integration/dsh.md>)。原文和校验信息保存在 [压缩归档](<vendor/j-space/canonical.tar.gz>) 与 [清单](<vendor/j-space/manifest.json>) 中。

这里的压缩用于保存和还原源文件，不会减少解压后送给模型的 token，也不会用摘要代替原文。原版的重复提示和定期完整重读方式没有改。

在已安装包的根目录运行以下命令，可以校验文件或还原归档：

```bash
python3 -B tools/upstream_integrity.py verify --runtime preset/skills/j-space --adapters vendor/j-space/adapters.json

readme.section: 输出目录必须尚不存在
readme.text:
python3 -B tools/upstream_integrity.py expand --output /tmp/j-space-original-restored
```

控制器仍需要智能体按协议调用；安装预设不会自动装上宿主事件拦截器。

下面的命令在完整仓库中执行。npm 包包含运行文件和 [校验工具](<tools/upstream_integrity.py>)，不包含本仓库的开发测试脚本。

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm run test:controller

另行安装隔离的 DSH 宿主后，可以检查官方配置和真实安装流程：

```bash
pnpm run test:host /path/to/isolated-host/node_modules 0.2.1-rc.4
pnpm run test:install /path/to/isolated-host/node_modules /absolute/plugin.tgz 0.2.1-rc.4
```

安装测试只创建新的临时 profile，不会修改正在使用的配置。1.2.5 已在 rc.3、rc.4 和 `0.2.2-alpha.2` 上验证原生安装、预设与技能加载，以及官方团队开关两种配置；没有做模型 A/B、真实团队对话、浏览器操作或定时投递测试。

上游作者发布了 [GLM-5.3-Flash 报告](https://github.com/Tiger3807861189/GLM-5.3-Flash-J-Space-Capability-Realization-Report) 和 [DeepSeek-V4 报告](https://github.com/Tiger3807861189/DeepSeek-V4-J-Space-Capability-Realization-Report)。这些是上游实验，不是这份 DSH 适配的实测成绩；本项目没有复现其中的性能或 token 收益。

DSH 包装代码使用 [MIT](<LICENSE>)；上游编写的 J-Space 代码和文本使用 [Apache-2.0](<vendor/j-space/LICENSE>)。第三方引文和轨迹片段不包含在上述授权中，仍适用各自的权利与条款。来源和具体范围见 [NOTICE](<NOTICE.md>) 及 [上游第三方声明](<vendor/j-space/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md>)。

[](<NOTICE.md>)

[简体中文](<README.md>) | **English**

Use [J-Space Cognition Suite](https://github.com/Tiger3807861189/J-Space-Cognition-Suite) in DeepSeek Harness. Install the package, then choose **J-Space Cognition Suite** when creating a session.

J-Space provides workflows for breaking down problems, exploring repositories, keeping task notes, and checking results. This package brings those workflows to DSH without replacing the original modules, controller, or workspace ledger. Models, tools, and permissions come from DSH; collaboration uses its official Agent Teams plugin.

The upstream project maintains J-Space itself. This repository maintains the DSH integration.

Version 1.2.5 was tested with **DSH 0.2.1-rc.4 / Cordis 4.0.5**, and also installed and loaded on `0.2.1-rc.3` and `0.2.2-alpha.2` (Cordis `4.0.6-alpha.1`). The commands below pin rc.4 rather than relying on npm tags: the `next` tag now points at it, while `latest` is still the older `0.2.1-rc.2`. The much older `0.2.0-rc.2` is missing a required scheduling tool and cannot fully load this preset, so upgrade first if you use it.

```bash

readme.section: Skip this if you already run the matching DSH version
readme.text:
npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.4

dsh plugin --profile web add @anonyjcy/dsh-j-space@1.2.5
```

For an existing deployment, upgrade the installation that actually starts your DSH process and back up custom settings first. Replace `web` with your profile name if needed.

readme.section: Skip this if you already run the matching DSH version
readme.text:
Restart DSH Web, create a session, and select **J-Space Cognition Suite** under **Agent Preset**. Installing the npm package in an ordinary project does not register it with DSH. There is no additional legacy `install` step.bash
git clone https://github.com/AnonyJcy/dsh-j-space.git
cd dsh-j-space
dsh plugin --profile web add "$PWD"
```

readme.section: Skip this if you already run the matching DSH version
readme.text:
DSH registers the preset through the [bundle configuration](<cordis.patch.yml>) and reads the [packaged skills](<preset/skills/j-space/>) directly. No manual copying is needed.

</details>

To use teams, install the official plugin in the same profile:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile@0.2.1-rc.4
```

The official plugin handles members, messages, task assignments, and member lifecycle. The J-Space preset no longer registers its own `subagent`, `fork`, or member-control tools. It does not enable teams automatically: creating a team requires an explicit user request. You can also use J-Space with a single agent.

The original [orchestration module](<preset/skills/j-space/modules/orchestration.md>) stays in place. It records work and review evidence, rather than managing a second team. Participants still need their own source reads, second consideration, and independent acceptance. The controller's `agent add` / `retire` commands record evidence roles; they do not create or stop DSH members.

`workflow` remains available for explicitly requested batch orchestration. Its children are not official Team members. See the [DSH integration notes](<preset/skills/j-space/integration/dsh.md>) for the details.

Update the package in the same profile, restart DSH Web, and create a new session.

If you saved a custom J-Space plugin configuration in the Web editor, back it up and reset the preset override, or remove the old `tool-subagent*` and Ralph entries manually. Otherwise, sessions may still use the old tool list after the package is updated. Load the official Team layer after the base / web layers.

Keep existing `.jspace/control.json` files and task records.

The [legacy CLI](<bin/cli.js>) is still included, but it only manages a file copy under `$DSH_HOME/.agent-presets/j-space`. Its `status` / `verify` commands cannot tell whether the current DSH preset is registered; check the new-session menu instead. The standalone Cordis deployment plugin also copies legacy files rather than registering a modern preset.

Release history is in the [changelog](<CHANGELOG.md>).

This package uses upstream SV1 at commit [b2023124](https://github.com/Tiger3807861189/J-Space-Cognition-Suite/tree/b2023124a1fa08278e3ee82aefa8ed9faeade995). All 13 modules, seven references, original examples, controller, and full reread routines are retained.

Of the 26 original skill files, 25 are byte-for-byte unchanged. The [skill entry](<preset/skills/j-space/SKILL.md>) adds a removable DSH note, with separate [integration notes](<preset/skills/j-space/integration/dsh.md>). A [compressed archive](<vendor/j-space/canonical.tar.gz>) and [hash manifest](<vendor/j-space/manifest.json>) preserve the originals for verification and restoration.

The archive compresses files, not model input. It does not replace original text with summaries or reduce the tokens needed to read it. Original repeated prompts and scheduled full rereads are unchanged.

Run these commands from the installed package root to verify the files or restore the archive:

```bash
python3 -B tools/upstream_integrity.py verify --runtime preset/skills/j-space --adapters vendor/j-space/adapters.json

readme.section: The destination must not already exist
readme.text:
python3 -B tools/upstream_integrity.py expand --output /tmp/j-space-original-restored
```

The agent still needs to follow the controller protocol. Installing the preset does not install host event hooks that enforce it automatically.

Run these from a full checkout. The npm package includes runtime files and the [integrity utility](<tools/upstream_integrity.py>), but not the development test harnesses.

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm run test:controller

With a separately installed, isolated DSH host, you can also check the official configuration and native installation:

```bash
pnpm run test:host /path/to/isolated-host/node_modules 0.2.1-rc.4
pnpm run test:install /path/to/isolated-host/node_modules /absolute/plugin.tgz 0.2.1-rc.4
```

The installation smoke uses fresh temporary profiles and leaves your active configuration untouched. Version 1.2.5 was checked on rc.3, rc.4, and `0.2.2-alpha.2` for native installation, preset and skill loading, and Team OFF/ON configuration. Model A/B comparisons, actual Team conversations, browser interaction, and scheduled delivery were not tested.

The upstream author has published reports for [GLM-5.3-Flash](https://github.com/Tiger3807861189/GLM-5.3-Flash-J-Space-Capability-Realization-Report) and [DeepSeek-V4](https://github.com/Tiger3807861189/DeepSeek-V4-J-Space-Capability-Realization-Report). These describe upstream experiments, not measurements of this DSH integration. This project has not reproduced their performance or token-efficiency results.
